reference_model: Floyd-Warshallと到達関係で有限距離/未到達/負閉路全下流を独立に計算。負閉路による参照内部の無制限減少だけを-INF/4でclampし、有限単純路の範囲より十分下に置く。参照内部のsigned overflowを避ける。
boundaries: 重み±1e9、零、自己辺、多重辺、前進/逆向き鎖、孤立始点、未到達の不正辺を走査しない条件、負閉路下流だけの-INF
5000個の小グラフに加え、65〜89頂点かつ始点出辺1本の400グラフでforward途中停止と引継ぎをFloyd参照へ照合。
通常の有界INF経路に加え、現実的な小グラフで内部の保守的sentinel経路を明示呼出しして同じ答えを確認。BFのUseActive有無のpublic境界とSPFA Small境界を含む。
始点-1/Vと参照辺終点-1/V、重み±1000000001を既定検査で拒否し、既存出力を保持。検査省略時に不正入力を与えない。

fault_injection: APIごと240ケース×GCC/Clang checked/skip。グラフ不変と生存割当数を確認。既定検査時は割当例外で古い出力を保持し、SKIP時にはその強い保証を主張しない。置換new/delete関数のテストをnoinlineとし、GCCによるmalloc/freeの誤った不一致警告を避ける。直接new式は追加しない。
sanitizers: 両API×checked/skipをClang ASan+UBSanで検査。topologicalで確認したptraceによるLSan制限に従いdetect_leaks=0。リークの補足は別の生存割当数検査に区別する。
preprocessor: 両compiler/両検査設定で、SKIP時の始点/辺重み検査除去と頂点数容量保護の保持を確認。
resource_limits: INT_MAX頂点や有限距離のINF境界を実メモリに構築していない。極大容量まで実走査したとは説明しない。
巨大頂点数用の保守的sentinel経路は小さい有効グラフで明示検査する。

make_inputs.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,random,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;(p/'inputs').mkdir(exist_ok=True);cases=[]
def put(name,n,edges,price=10,sample=None):
 text=f'{n} {len(edges)} {price}\n'+''.join(f'{a+1} {b+1} {c}\n' for a,b,c in edges);f=p/'inputs'/f'{name}.in';f.write_text(text)
 cases.append({'case':name,'n':n,'m':len(edges),'input':str(f),'expected':str(f.with_suffix('.out')),'kind':'official_sample' if sample is not None else 'custom_problem_domain','sample_output':sample,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
put('sample1',3,[(0,1,20),(1,2,30),(0,2,45)],sample='35\n');put('sample2',2,[(0,1,100),(1,1,100)],sample='-1\n');put('sample3',4,[(0,1,1),(0,3,1),(2,3,1),(1,1,100),(2,2,100)],sample='0\n')
n=2500;rng=random.Random(0x842397)
put('forward_profit',n,[(i-1,i,11) for i in range(1,n)])
put('forward_nonnegative',n,[(i-1,i,9) for i in range(1,n)])
perm=[0]+list(range(n-2,0,-1))+[n-1];put('reverse_profit',n,[(a,b,11) for a,b in zip(perm,perm[1:])])
put('star',n,[(0,i,10+i%3) for i in range(1,n)]+[(i,n-1,11) for i in range(1,n-1)])
for kind in ['random_dag','permuted_dag']:
 perm=list(range(1,n-1));rng.shuffle(perm);perm=[0]+perm+[n-1] if kind=='permuted_dag' else list(range(n));pairs={(i-1,i) for i in range(1,n)}
 while len(pairs)<5000:
  a=rng.randrange(n-1);b=rng.randrange(a+1,n);pairs.add((a,b))
 es=[(perm[a],perm[b],rng.randint(1,21)) for a,b in pairs];rng.shuffle(es);put(kind,n,es)
es=[(0,n-1,50000)]+[(rng.randrange(n),rng.randrange(n),rng.randint(1,100000)) for _ in range(4999)];put('random_cycles',n,es,50000)
put('reachable_negative_self',n,[(i-1,i,11) for i in range(1,n)]+[(n//2,n//2,11)])
put('reachable_negative_backedge',n,[(i-1,i,11) for i in range(1,n)]+[(n//2,n//2-17,10)])
put('nonnegative_backedge',n,[(i-1,i,21) for i in range(1,n)]+[(n//2,n//2-17,1)],price=20)
put('negative_not_target',n,[(0,n-1,11),(0,n//2,11),(n//2,n//2,11)])
put('unreachable_negative',n,[(0,n-1,11)]+[(i,i,11) for i in range(1,n-1)])
put('spfa_reverse_queue',n,[(0,i,10) for i in range(n-1,0,-1)]+[(i,i+1,11) for i in range(1,n-1)])
# Smaller fixed-main inputs exercise the <=64 cutover.
for n in [32,64,65]:put(f'small_chain_{n}',n,[(i-1,i,11) for i in range(1,n)])
(p/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(cases),'cases')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');frozen=Path('/tmp/sirkit_four_hours_20261022/baseline');cases=json.loads((p/'inputs.json').read_text());records=[]
for cc,compiler in [('gcc','g++'),('clang','clang++')]:
 for skip in [False,True]:
  flags=['-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror']
  if cc=='clang':flags+=['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']
  if skip:flags+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
  for id,lib in [('bellman_ford','Bellman-Ford.cpp'),('spfa','Bellman-Ford_SFPA.cpp'),('graph_local',None)]:
   sub=(frozen/'Verify/current/submissions'/f'{id}.cpp').read_text();sub=sub.replace('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n','')
   for name in ([lib] if lib else ['Bellman-Ford.cpp','Bellman-Ford_SFPA.cpp']):
    old=(frozen/'Graph'/name).read_text();assert sub.count(old)==1;sub=sub.replace(old,(root/'Graph'/name).read_text())
   tu=p/f'verify_{cc}_{skip}_{id}.cpp';tu.write_text(sub);exe=tu.with_suffix('');cmd=['taskset','-c','8',compiler,*flags,str(tu),'-o',str(exe)];x=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert x.returncode==0,(cmd,x.stderr)
   for case in ([{'case':'existing_local','input':None,'expected':None,'kind':'supplementary'}] if lib is None else cases):
    data=Path(case['input']).read_bytes() if case['input'] else b'';expected=Path(case['expected']).read_bytes().split() if case['expected'] else [b'OK'];run=['taskset','-c','8',str(exe)];x=subprocess.run(run,input=data,capture_output=True);assert x.returncode==0 and x.stdout.split()==expected,(id,cc,skip,case['case'],x.stdout,x.stderr)
    records.append({'id':id,'compiler':cc,'skip':skip,'case':case['case'],'kind':case['kind'],'command':cmd,'run_command':run,'stdout':x.stdout.decode(),'input_sha256':case.get('input_sha256'),'expected_sha256':case.get('expected_sha256'),'returncode':x.returncode})
  print(cc,skip,'PASS',flush=True)
(p/'main_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');records=[]
for name,source,api in [('bellman_ford',root/'Graph/Bellman-Ford.cpp','BellmanFord'),('spfa',root/'Graph/Bellman-Ford_SFPA.cpp','SPFA'),('spfa_isolated',p.parent/'spfa/isolated.hpp','SPFA')]:
 for cc,compiler in [('gcc','g++'),('clang','clang++')]:
  for skip in [False,True]:
   flags=['-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors']
   if cc=='clang':flags+=['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']
   if skip:flags+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   exe=p/f'{name}_{cc}_{skip}';cmd=['taskset','-c','8',compiler,*flags,'-DSIRKIT_TEST_NEGATIVE_PATH_SOURCE="'+str(source)+'"','-DSIRKIT_TEST_NEGATIVE_PATH_API='+api,'-DSIRKIT_TEST_NEGATIVE_PATH_KIND='+('1' if api=='BellmanFord' else '2'),str(p/'reference_test.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)];x=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True);assert x.returncode==0,(cmd,x.stderr);x=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','8',str(exe)],text=True,capture_output=True);print(name,cc,skip,x.returncode,x.stdout,x.stderr,flush=True);records.append({'name':name,'compiler':cc,'skip':skip,'command':cmd,'returncode':x.returncode,'stdout':x.stdout,'stderr':x.stderr});assert x.returncode==0
(p/'baseline_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
